instructions: Consolidate the candidates into a MECE taxonomy. Each final persona needs a unique 'codename' (plus 'label', 'description', 'quantitative_signals', 'example_comments'). Set status='APPROVED' before Stage 2.

final_taxonomy.label: The Superfan
final_taxonomy.description: A highly dedicated and long-term follower who comments frequently, early, and enthusiastically across a wide range of content. They express a strong personal connection and are a foundational part of the community.
quantitative_signals: Engages with diverse content types (humor, personal, sponsored)
example_comments: Cami, le tue espressioni mi spezzano 😂
ecco dove avevo lasciato la mia giovinezza. grazie mille cami, apprezzo di cuore
Il Sig. Cazz0. Chiudete l'internet. E anche oggi tvb

final_taxonomy.label: The Social Sharer
final_taxonomy.description: This user's primary mode of engagement is tagging friends to share content they find relatable, funny, or interesting. Their comments act as a bridge, bringing their personal network into the influencer's orbit.
quantitative_signals: Very low average word count (1-5 words)
Motivation is sharing, not direct conversation with the influencer
High engagement on humorous or relatable content
example_comments: @valentinapannullo tipo noi
@__lucreziaaa__ mi ricorda il primo esame di qualcun'altro
@leoninoemi26 @federicads95

final_taxonomy.label: The Minimalist Reactor
final_taxonomy.description: Communicates almost exclusively through emojis or single words to express immediate emotional reactions like laughter, love, or applause. They provide quick, low-effort feedback that signals content resonance.
quantitative_signals: Comments are often single emojis or a flood of the same emoji

final_taxonomy.label: The Cheerleader
final_taxonomy.description: Consistently leaves short, enthusiastic, and positive comments expressing admiration and support. They are a reliable source of encouragement, celebrating the influencer's content, appearance, and achievements.
example_comments: Sei pazzescaaaaaa
Che. Meraviglia.
Stupenda è poco!!! Wow 😍

final_taxonomy.label: The Empathic Storyteller
final_taxonomy.description: Connects deeply with the influencer's personal narratives by sharing their own detailed anecdotes, vulnerabilities, and emotional reflections. Their comments build a sense of shared human experience and empathy.
quantitative_signals: Comments are narrative and share personal experiences
High use of emotive language and emojis
Engages with personal, vulnerable, or reflective content
example_comments: Anche a mia nonna sembrava potesse sfuggire tutto ma non il suo colore preferito: il roseo. Cosa curiosa questa brutta malattia, ti porta via un pezzo alla volta mentre ti aggrappi a piccoli ricordi di te.
Ho sofferto di emicrania molto forti dall'età di 17 anni...

Una relazione a distanza non è mai facile. È a volte frustrante, triste e molto difficile ma quando si supera questa fase e si uniscono le forze, diventa la dimostrazione di quanto è forte un rapporto.

final_taxonomy.label: The Community Builder
final_taxonomy.description: Actively fosters conversation by replying to other commenters, asking questions, and participating in discussions. They treat the comment section as a social space for interaction with peers.
quantitative_signals: Often tags other users in replies
example_comments: @silviacerigioni l ho quasi imparata occhioooooo
@lucrezianiscosarlo ahahahahahahahahahahhaha no io lei la amo
@enricomelox sembra diventata una strana moda questa

final_taxonomy.label: The Humor Appreciator
final_taxonomy.description: Specifically engages with humorous or ironic content, often responding with witty remarks, inside jokes, or their own comedic take. Their comments build on the playful tone of the post.
quantitative_signals: Comments are witty, sarcastic, or add to the joke
High use of laughing emojis or informal language
Can have a high word count when telling a related joke
example_comments: Vabbè lui ci crede un botto, è fortissimo.
La prima foto fa molto: it's always me and you, and your friend Steve 😂
Tua sorella fa i bofffffolotti!

final_taxonomy.label: The Curious Inquirer
final_taxonomy.description: Uses the comment section to seek information, asking direct questions about products, locations, personal details, or context mentioned in the post. Their engagement is driven by a practical need for knowledge.
quantitative_signals: Often asks 'where can I buy...?' or 'what is...?'
Engagement is often transactional and information-driven
example_comments: Ti posso chiedere che rossetto indossi...grazie
dove l'hai comprata? la vorrei anche io 😊
non ho capito,chi mi spiega?

final_taxonomy.label: The Thoughtful Contributor
final_taxonomy.description: Provides detailed, well-reasoned comments that offer analysis, expert advice, or a deep perspective on the post's topic. They elevate the conversation with substantive and often lengthy contributions.
quantitative_signals: Comments are analytical, advisory, or philosophical
Often engages with more serious or complex topics
example_comments: Fare sport significa tutto e niente. C'è dentro il rugby e il nuoto.
Purtroppo il nascondersi dietro a uno schermo ha dato una scusa alle persone a dare il peggio di sé e a sfogare le proprie frustrazioni.
Comunque in questi giorni non faccio che pensare che non ti saresti mai e poi mai dovuta iscrivere in palestra. Questa situazione è la vendetta del Dio Divano.

final_taxonomy.label: The Casual Observer
final_taxonomy.description: Represents the long tail of engagement, commenting infrequently with short, often generic, remarks. Their interaction is sporadic and low-effort, often occurring long after the post is published.
quantitative_signals: High average hours to comment (late engagement)
example_comments: Mitica
Sta matta!
La vita scivola via

final_taxonomy.label: The Skeptic & Critic
final_taxonomy.description: Engages by offering critical feedback, factual corrections, or a contrarian viewpoint. Their comments challenge the influencer or other commenters, fostering debate or expressing dissent.
quantitative_signals: Comments express negative or critical opinions
May have a confrontational or judgmental tone
example_comments: Ma se sei la regina della digital distorsion! Un'altro brand da boicottare. Che delusione @dove
Sesto Campano è in Molise...
"beacause"

final_taxonomy.label: The Event Follower
final_taxonomy.description: Engages specifically with time-sensitive content like tour announcements, ticket sales, or live events. Their comments express excitement, frustration with availability, or requests for their city to be included.
quantitative_signals: Frequently an early commenter on announcement posts
example_comments: È tutto il giorno che proviamo ma nulla.. sold out in pochissimo, speriamo nelle nuove date :(
Palermo pleaseeee😢❤️
Cami, aggiungi Foggia o Bari🤞🏻🤞🏻🤞🏻
